propositions: Pin the reconciler Backend interface and route the core through it so a second backend can be added by implementing adapters/<x>/ without a core rewrite.

Enforce the canonical-comparison principle: core compares only canonical local-vocabulary shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads via port calls at emission and ingestion boundaries.
Extending the Backend port with vendor-shaped outbound differ comparison helpers was blocked by plan review because ADR 0035 §(d) says the core owns diff/apply and the port only translates.
Bring the outbound differ, link differ, absence probe, and rich-text/comment-limit paths to parity with the already-canonical inbound differ.

Physically relocate remaining Jira vendor modules into adapters/jira/ and eliminate all vendor reach-through (imports, lazy-key literals, by-path loads) from package-root core modules, with inbound_fields.py as the sole recorded exemption.
Ensure all core modules respect the 800-LOC module-size gate and that the full suite remains behavior-preserving with default backend 'jira' reproducing prior behavior.
